hypotheses.explanation: Ignoring the requested sensor narrows the field of view. At the same lens, 36 instead of 48 produces approximately 1.33 times the projected scale, consistent with the global enlargement.

camera_calibration.reason: Requested sensor is 48*0.85=40.8; the code returns 36. The defined residual is 4.8/40.8, approximately 0.117647.

geometry_replay.reason: Emission multiplies geometry_frame by the primitive world matrix and preserves that world matrix after parenting. Expected discrepancies are numerical.

position_replay.reason: The same matrix composition preserves primitive origins; the recorded desk translation also matches offset plus final_move.

visibility_isolation.reason: StudyPanel has an emitted mesh, and the visibility helper recursively sets hide_render on both group and descendants.

support_relation.reason: With Floor.001 as the surface, the helper corrects the descendant AABB bottom to the floor top. Allowance covers evaluation and numerical uncertainty.

dependency_move.reason: The five desk meshes belong to their named part markers, which belong to StudyDesk; they should follow group movement.

material_dependency.reason: Mesh and material copies should isolate Top.001, supported by the supplied passing edit check. Zero is expected; the interval allows an unobserved ownership or execution issue.

hypotheses.explanation: A scene-wide geometry/frame scale mismatch could also enlarge the room and furnishings relative to the camera. This is substantially weaker: the recorded dimensions match the specification and the supplied emitter preserves geometry_frame. A mismatch already embedded in public frames could evade replay against those same frames.

camera_calibration.reason: The supplied sensor hardcoding exists under this explanation too. Its measured residual establishes that contract violation, but does not exclude a concurrent geometry issue.

geometry_replay.reason: The supplied emitter should agree with public geometry_frame even if those frames encode an appearance mismatch. No alternative scale arithmetic is supported by the code.

position_replay.reason: A geometry-scale explanation does not imply incorrect translations relative to public frames; the supplied position composition remains consistent.

visibility_isolation.reason: Geometry scale does not change the recursive visibility contract or the observed existence of StudyPanel.001.

support_relation.reason: The AABB correction should work even for differently scaled geometry when supplied Floor.001.

dependency_move.reason: A scale mismatch does not imply a broken hierarchy; the recorded named part parenting is intact.

material_dependency.reason: The same copy-before-edit implementation and passing isolation evidence apply. Zero remains expected.

raw_evidence.source_scope: Actual SceneAct Blender compiler plus visibility/support/edit interfaces; controlled scene-description-to-Blender program repair, not natural-image end-to-end H

non_target.comparison: Exact direct comparison of matrices, local vertices, material values/nodes and parent; no hashes

raw_evidence.requirements: Compile a reusable SceneAct scene plan, retain intended world transforms and visibility, support composite furniture, preserve dependencies under group movement and local edits. Use images as desired appearance; investigate any shared module.

plan.reason: Structured evidence only; no active experimentation. Actual lower tool cost recorded.
